stock_daily.purpose: normalized raw prices with recovered dates and retained provenance

etf_daily.purpose: registered ETF daily bars enriched with provider turnover, volume, previous close and trade status

financials.purpose: offline reprocessed 2026-10-07 current financial snapshot; source retrieval timestamps unknown, original historical vintages unverified

action_samples.purpose: local stock-pool dividend/bonus snapshot plus six ETF event sources; incomplete event types and five quarantined disagreements

sse_calendar.purpose: SSE scheduled sessions from official annual notices and amendments; independently compared with five ETF samples, not security tradability

security_metadata.purpose: official listing and termination candidates, SZSE name events, SSE current stock list, and separate current metadata; lifecycle and historical trading eligibility remain unverified

financial_availability.purpose: announcement-date sampling against retained raw provider captures

szse_calendar.purpose: SZSE scheduled sessions from official annual notices and amendments; complements the registered SSE calendar

daily_bar_enriched.purpose: price-limit recheck over the acquired universe (ChiNext ETF 20% rule applied); zero breaches under derived limits

stock_status_reference.purpose: provider-reported halt and ST observations for the 240-symbol sample; never execution eligibility

adjusted_prices.purpose: backward-adjusted price series; same-ex-date plan components combined before applying the exchange ex-reference formula

etf_universe.purpose: baostock provider listing/termination dates for the ETF universe; provider dates not independently verified

adjustment_residuals.purpose: item-by-item enumeration of residual adjustment jumps beyond price limits

listing_supplement.purpose: provider listing references for codes the official snapshots do not cover

delisting_boundaries.purpose: per-security delisting-boundary decision state from registered evidence

session_gaps.purpose: enumerated bar-missing sessions per security, so the gate verifies registered evidence instead of re-reading every series on each run
